intro: This report provides a comprehensive and up-to-date overview of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) product migration to the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE). It details the ingestion status of the extensive CLMS product portfolio, categorised by global, Pan-European, and priority area products. The document clearly outlines the availability of various product groups across key CDSE data access services, including S3, OData, STAC, OpenEO, and Sentinel Hub. This weekly updated report is essential for scientists, regulators, and data engineers to monitor the accessibility and progress of CLMS data dissemination.
